entities.name: eIF3 subunit I
observations: 350 aa protein; exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt Q5AI86 from Candida albicans.
Annotated as a component of the eukaryotic translation initiation factor 3 complex.
Contains an EIF3I domain spanning approximately residues 1–337 and multiple WD40-like repeats.
Reference annotations include RNA binding and translation initiation factor activity.
Reference localization is cytoplasmic, with an additional nuclear-periphery cellular-component annotation.
No explicit catalytic reaction or enzyme activity was retrieved; this is consistent with a nonenzymatic eIF3 scaffold/adaptor role.

entities.name: eIF3 complex
observations: Eukaryotic translation initiation complex that promotes assembly of 43S and 48S preinitiation complexes and supports mRNA and initiator methionyl-tRNA recruitment to the 40S ribosome.

entities.name: Cytoplasmic translation initiation
observations: The matched protein is annotated in cytoplasmic translational initiation and formation of the cytoplasmic translation initiation complex.
